text:
Alyssa (Sales): Hey team—AcmeCorp POC stuck. They can't create hosted API keys via the console after we turned on SSO. IDP (Okta) shows groups attribute flagged as 'hidden' and their SCIM bulk sync hit rate limits. Can we unblock today? Lara (customer) is on the call 10am PT.

AcmeCorp IT - Lara: Confirming. When I try /admin/api-keys I get 403 SSO_ENFORCED and console suggests 'contact your admin'. Also our SCIM sync logs show 429 on /Users endpoint after ~250 users.

Priya (Solutions): Thanks Lara. Two things to untangle: (1) API key flow with SSO enforced (we should allow service-account tokens for POCs), (2) SCIM error + groups hidden — if IdP hides group claims, our group provisioning won't create team memberships. Jordan, can you check SSO config and SCIM mapping?

Jordan (Eng): Looking. For hosted API keys, we require a linked service account when SSO is enforced; I can temporarily enable 'allow_poc_api_keys' flag for this tenant if Marco signs off. For SCIM, if groups claim arrives as 'urn:okta:groups' but flagged 'hidden', Okta sends it only to user-specific apps, not SCIM service — sample SAML snippet from their assertion: 
```xml
<Attribute Name="groups" NameFormat="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:uri" FriendlyName="Groups" xsi:nil="true"/>
```
That xsi:nil is the issue.

Marco (SecOps): We're cautious enabling flags. Before we toggle, need confirmation of scope: will this create long-lived API keys? Let's do time-limited service-account tokens (7 days) with audit trail. I'll approve if Solutions attach an RBAC policy 'poc-readwrite' and explicit expiration.

Priya (Solutions): Plan: 1) Create service-account token for AcmeCorp tenant scoped to 'poc-readwrite', expires in 7d. 2) Enable temporary flag allow_poc_api_keys. 3) For SCIM/groups: ask customer to enable 'groups' as a claim for the Redwood SAML app in Okta or we can configure group sync via SCIM mapping (group creation) but needs admin consent. Lara — can you toggle groups claim visibility or give us a screenshot of the Okta app mapping?

AcmeCorp IT - Lara: I can turn on groups but it's a global change in Okta — trying to avoid. Alternative: can you accept SCIM group creation from the SCIM token side? Our IdP admin won't disclose groups to third-party apps.

Jordan (Eng): We can support group creation via SCIM if Okta will at least allow outbound SCIM to our service account. The bigger blocker is their SCIM endpoint hitting Okta rate limits during bulk import — we saw 429 at 250 users. Two mitigations: (a) implement incremental provisioning with backoff (we already have 429 handling but not at that rate), (b) ask customer to bump SCIM rate limit on Okta side or perform in cohorts.

Alyssa (Sales): Lara, would doing cohorts (50 users at a time) be feasible? That might be fastest to unblock the POC today.

AcmeCorp IT - Lara: Yes cohorts ok for now. I'll disable 'hide group claims' for Redwood app after I run it by internal security; might be a few hours. Please proceed with service-account token.

Marco (SecOps): I'll generate a one-off service account token scoped to 'poc-readwrite', expiration 7d. Audit includes tenant id and issuing note 'sales-poc-acmecorp-1749532100'. Jordan — ensure token only works for hosted API and SCIM endpoints, not infra ops.

Jordan (Eng): Confirmed. I'll also patch SCIM client to backoff at 5s with jitter after 429 and chunk size default to 40 for this tenant. Deploying now to staging, will flip for AcmeCorp once Marco posts the token.

DeployBot: rolling update: scim-client v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4 to staging (ids: canary-7).

Priya (Solutions): Thanks everyone. Lara — once Marco posts token, share the service-account id and I'll coordinate with you to run a cohort sync.

AcmeCorp IT - Lara: token received, tested - can create api key via POST /v1/admin/service-accounts -> 201. SCIM cohort worked (first 40 users), no 429. We're green to continue the POC. :tada:

Alyssa (Sales): Awesome. Next steps: Priya to run onboarding checklist, Jordan to monitor SCIM error rates for 24h, Marco to revoke token after 7d. I'll update the deal notes.
